WITH ball_extras AS (
  SELECT match_id, over_id, ball_id, SUM(extra_runs) as total_extra
  FROM extra_runs
  GROUP BY match_id, over_id, ball_id
),
ball_runs AS (
  SELECT 
    b.match_id,
    b.over_id,
    b.ball_id,
    b.innings_no,
    b.bowler,
    COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) as batsman_runs,
    COALESCE(be.total_extra, 0) as extra_runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  LEFT JOIN ball_extras be ON b.match_id = be.match_id AND b.over_id = be.over_id AND b.ball_id = be.ball_id
),
over_runs AS (
  SELECT 
    match_id,
    over_id,
    innings_no,
    bowler,
    SUM(batsman_runs + extra_runs) as runs_in_over
  FROM ball_runs
  WHERE bowler IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY match_id, over_id, innings_no, bowler
),
match_max_over_runs AS (
  SELECT 
    match_id,
    MAX(runs_in_over) as max_runs_in_match
  FROM over_runs
  GROUP BY match_id
),
max_overs AS (
  SELECT o.match_id, o.over_id, o.innings_no, o.bowler, o.runs_in_over
  FROM over_runs o
  JOIN match_max_over_runs om ON o.match_id = om.match_id
  WHERE o.runs_in_over = om.max_runs_in_match
),
bowler_max_runs AS (
  SELECT bowler, MAX(runs_in_over) as max_runs
  FROM max_overs
  GROUP BY bowler
  ORDER BY max_runs DESC, bowler ASC
  LIMIT 3
),
bowler_matches AS (
  SELECT mo.bowler, mo.match_id, mo.runs_in_over
  FROM max_overs mo
  JOIN bowler_max_runs bm ON mo.bowler = bm.bowler AND mo.runs_in_over = bm.max_runs
)
SELECT 
  p.player_name,
  bm.match_id,
  bmr.max_runs
FROM bowler_matches bm
JOIN player p ON p.player_id = bm.bowler
JOIN bowler_max_runs bmr ON bm.bowler = bmr.bowler
